name: kr.co.querymind/connect
title: QueryMind
description: Read-only answers from your business database, with the SQL and conditions behind each number.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Describe the connected data source, access limits and setup status. Before sign-in, returns public connection guidance only.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Send a natural-language question to the analysis engine. Reads business data without modifying it, but creates QueryMind query jobs, audit records, conversation context and usage records. Returns an answer, state, limited result rows and evidence. If state=clarifying_question, ask the user the returned question before calling clarify.

question.description: The user's natural-language data question; preserve their business meaning.

tools.name: clarify
tools.description: Continue the previous ask after the engine requests clarification. May create a QueryMind query job and update audit records, conversation context and usage records; business data remains read-only. Send the user's choice or additional explanation; do not invent their choice.

choice.description: The user's choice or additional explanation.

tools.name: result
tools.description: Retrieve the answer, state, limited result rows and evidence for the job_id returned by ask or clarify with state=pending. Completing retrieval can record QueryMind usage; business data remains read-only.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by ask or clarify.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Show the data source, query conditions (SQL), time basis and access restrictions for a recent answer accessible to this connection.

audit_id.description: Omit to explain the most recent ask answer.

tools.name: connect_database
tools.description: Create a secure setup link for the user's business database. Show the link to the user. Credentials must be entered there, never in chat. The link expires in 10 minutes and is single-use. Use a read-only database account.

kind.description: postgres, mysql, mssql or oracle; omit if unknown.

name.description: Optional display name for this database.

tools.name: onboard
tools.description: Start a durable job to learn the connected database structure. Reuses a running job for the same database. Check onboarding_status; candidates requiring approval are handled with review.

tools.name: onboarding_status
tools.description: Return onboarding stage, status and next steps, with question examples when available.

job_id.description: Omit for the most recent onboarding job for the current database.

tools.name: define
tools.description: Propose a business definition for this user's questions only. First send term and definition, then show the preview to the user. Send confirm_token only after their explicit confirmation. Use undo_def_id to undo or list=true to list definitions.

confirm_token.description: Token from a preview explicitly approved by the user.

undo_def_id.description: ID of a personal definition to undo.

list.description: Set true to list personal definitions.

tools.name: review
tools.description: List or propose approval/rejection of onboarding candidates (table labels, joins, code dictionaries). An administrator must confirm changes through a secure reauthentication link.

tools.name: set_access_rule
tools.description: Propose which rows a role can access. Changes take effect only after an administrator reauthenticates and confirms through a secure link, never through chat alone.

table.description: Table to which the rule applies.

predicate.description: SQL WHERE condition, for example dept_id = 101.

description.description: Business explanation of the proposed rule.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Return this month's question usage, account limits and connected database count.

tools.name: invite
tools.description: Administrators can create a single-use invitation link valid for 24 hours. Share the link yourself; this tool does not send email. The recipient signs in or signs up through the link and uses the same connector address.

email.description: Recipient email, which becomes their login ID.

role.description: Role in the organization; defaults to analyst.
